intended_claim: R08-A provides defensible saved-evidence observations, a current-code-consistent joint model, and a bounded executable proposal for separately authorized future stages; it does not establish new DRL benefit.
confidence_scope: High confidence in the saved-data arithmetic, current-code semantics and evidential limits; future opportunity, learning, throughput and generalization remain unknown.
scope: Only R08-A saved-data analysis, mathematical/source audit, pure interfaces and proposed B-E design. No old60, oldS3 task/route or confirmation/final semantics accessed; no Git operations.
what_support: Saved complete routes show reproducible configuration-set, connection/order and induced assignment differences after common H.
Training352 teacher gap is 3.8544484076 percent under parent-equal task-relative aggregation and 3.8900054811 percent under the older parent-mean-J convention; these are separate estimands.
Current K, same-arm F-and-allow legality, endpoint distances, earliest-service responsibility and exporter-specific L priority can be represented consistently.
The corrected finite joint-edit proposal has explicit menus, lower processing, STOP/H treatment, controls, budgets, gates and authorization boundaries.
The current implementation honestly consists of types, saved-data adapters and synthetic contract tests rather than a real learned runtime.
what_not_support: The saved teacher gap is not a causal decomposition into independent set, ordering or assignment benefits.
No new joint-action opportunity, learned quality gain, strong-baseline superiority or speed gain has been measured.
No claim of fresh-parent generalization, real IK, arm swept-path safety or physical execution is supported.
Interface PASS, a feasible-looking proposal and historical losses/gradients do not establish new DRL effectiveness.
B-E execution is not authorized by completion of A or by this verdict.
missing_evidence: Separately authorized B: real legal-menu coverage, bounded one-edit H opportunity curves, preserved routes and actual processing times.
Separately authorized C: real transitions, masks, STOP equivalence, finite gradients, whitelist, exact numerical checkpoint recovery and frozen export equivalence.
Separately authorized D: fixed128 quality against FrozenSL, matched SL, RuleMenu and true Single-RL, pre-protection candidates and full computation/time accounting.
Separately authorized E: all three seeds, registered new-parent confirmation/final evaluations, native strong-baseline target and complete cold/hot deployment timing.
resolved_findings: Single-RL now has an independently generated genuine single-edit menu rather than an empty filter of fixed two-drop actions.
Drop/add intersections are cancelled before action deduplication and actual-arity accounting.
Supervision order distance is an explicit retained-order proxy without solving unchosen actions.
R07 evidence links identify the correct route and phase, including same-branch raw-to-H; archive references are separate.
The derived source index no longer includes its own obsolete hash; analysis and metadata costs are separated.
D nested-request arithmetic and deployment before/after reuse are explicit and consistent.
E mode, allow condition, windows and endpoint selection are fixed in the proposal.
L priority is correctly attributed to the exporter rather than to the validator.
The final overall target explicitly distinguishes SL increment from superiority to native strong rules.
suggested_claim_revision: R08-A documents a reproducible observed gap and a bounded candidate to test it. New joint-action and learned-planning benefits remain hypotheses.
